steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hoo... hoo...
The corridors inside the palace are intricate and complex. You barge your way through, losing some of your pursuers.

steps.speaker: Manic Desert Bandit
steps.content: Roarrrr...!! Roarrrr!!
It's useless to keep running. There's a constant stream of desert bandits. You're bound to get caught by them at some point. Send a signal to Hecate now!
Beep—

steps.speaker: Manic Desert Bandit
steps.content: Roarrrr...!! Roarrrr!!
You look around and find no suitable weapons to defend yourself against the attacks. There is only a long, unknown path behind you.
You decide to keep running. With a bit of luck, you might be able to lose these desert bandits inside the maze-like palace.
The desert bandits detect your location and rush toward you.
Endless corrosion by time and sand has rendered the palace floors brittle and fragile, incapable of sustaining such commotion.
A single fissure splits across the floor, followed by countless cracks criss-crossing into one another. Finally, a gaping hole opens up as the floor crumbles beneath your feet!
You and the Manic monsters fall together into the endless abyss...
Ruined palace, underground.
A sharp pain sears your back as you struggle to get up. You realize you've fallen on a man-made platform... It's almost as if its job is to catch you.
The ground around you is littered with fragments of the monsters' limbs.
So you've come. Missed me that much?
That familiar voice, that familiar tone... You look up frantically...
She perches lightly on a stone nearby, just like she did before when running away from you. She is smiling, but her eyes are filled with pity and derision.
Just as you open your mouth to say something, you suddenly discover that nestled behind Stargazer is... A gigantic monster!

A tangle of vines twist and entwine each other, dripping sticky liquid like putrid flesh rotting off a corpse. At the top of the suffocating cluster is an organism that looks both like a blooming flower and a human face, heaving quietly as if it is breathing.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Little one, this is... the Dreamflower.
